WIPERS AND WASHERS
Troubleshooting

Problem | Possible cause | Remedy | Page Front | Rear

Wipers do not operate or return to off position | WIPER fuse blown | Replace fuse and check for short | BE-4 | BE-4
 | Wiper motor faulty | Check motor | BE-24 | BE-25
 | Wiper switch faulty | Check switch | BE-22 | BE-25
 | Wiring or ground faulty | Repair as necessary | |

Wipers do not operate in INT position | Wiper relay faulty | Check relay | BE-23 | BE-25
 | Wiper switch faulty | Check switch | BE-22 | BE-25
 | Wiper motor faulty | Check motor | BE-24 | BE-25
 | Wiring or ground faulty | Repair as necessary | |

Washers do not operate | Washer hose or nozzle clogged | Repair as necessary | |
 | Washer motor faulty | Replace motor | |
 | Wiper switch faulty | Check switch | BE-22 | BE-25
 | Wiring faulty | Repair as necessary | |
